newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Brewery to invest $25 mln in malthouse in Russia.
newsitem.headline: Brewery to invest $25 mln in malthouse in Russia.

text.p: Baltika Brewery, a subsidary of Baltic Beverages Holding (BBH), said on Wednesday it would invest $25 million in a malthouse in St Petersburg in Russia along with France's Groupe Soufflet.
Baltic Beverages Holding is jointly owned by Pripps Ringnes AB and Finland's Hartwall and owns seven breweries in the Baltic states, Russia and Ukraine, Pripps Ringnes said in a statement.
Baltika Brewery would own 30 percent of the Russian malthouse and the French company, 70 percent.
Pripps Ringnes AB is owned by Norwegian conglomerate Orkla ASA.
Full capacity would be 150,000 tonnes annually and the plant would meet 40 percent of Russia's malt demand when it is complete in 1999, it said.
